objective: Add a bounded per-run model-route evidence record that states selection, fallback and reason, actual and shadow cost, and local-evidence completeness, without choosing a route.
decision_supported: Can a reviewer tell which route ran, whether it fell back and what it cost? Not from a free-form model_route string; the record now answers all five questions.
acceptance: A record names the selected route, the fallback reason and the costs.
An unknown fallback reason or evidence state is refused rather than omitted.
A non-finite or negative cost or latency is refused.
A run with no records summarises as unrecorded, not compliant.
stop_conditions: The change would approve a cloud provider.
risks_and_fallbacks: The record is additive and does not change routing; wiring it into every call site is a follow-up.
